explanation: The solution of a system is the point that lies on BOTH lines at once — where they cross. Slide the slopes and intercepts: when the lines have different slopes there's exactly one crossing; give them the same slope and they're parallel (no solution) or identical (infinitely many). The pulsing dot marks the solution.
bullets: A solution satisfies every equation at the same time.
Different slopes -> one intersection; equal slopes -> parallel or identical.
Graphing finds it visually; elimination/substitution find it exactly.
